critical_code_review_comments: PUT /api/company/jobs/{id} forcibly resets status to pending even when trivial edits are made — good for moderation but harsh UX. Consider a lighter 'edit-active-without-resubmit' path for typo fixes (or explicit 'submit for re-review' toggle).

Admin PUT /api/admin/jobs/{id} accepts full JobIn payload but does not regenerate slug when title/location change. If admin edits title heavily, the SEO slug can become stale. Consider regenerating slug (with redirect) or exposing an explicit slug field.
Company cross-tenant PUT correctly returns 404 (find_one filter includes company_id). Returning 403 would be more semantically correct but 404 also avoids info-leak — acceptable.
Seed job list has grown to 16 entries embedded in server.py (~lines 850-965). Extract to /app/backend/seed_data.py or JSON to keep server.py under 700 lines (echoed from iter1).
Console shows 401 on /api/auth/me for anonymous visitors on homepage — expected but noisy; consider suppressing via response check-before-request or 200-with-null-user pattern.
